Apple Arcade adds new games every month, with no ads and no in-app purchases. According to Apple's latest announcement, five new games will be released next month.

Apple Arcade October New Additions: 'Pusheen the Cat', 'Terraria+', and More

The App Store has countless games, but many are plagued by ads or endless in-app purchases.

Apple Arcade is different. It's a carefully curated gaming platform with over 200 premium games, completely free of ads and in-app purchases.

New games are added every month. Apple has just announced that five titles will be released on October 1st.

  • Pusheen's Place: "Build a cosy little world for Pusheen and collect over 100 adorable kitties"
  • River City Survivors: "An action-packed survivors-style game where players take on wave after wave of zombie mayhem"
  • Terraria+: "A sandbox action-adventure game where players can battle, explore, and build, gradually expanding an ever-growing world"
  • Touchgrind BMX 2+: "A physics-driven BMX stunt game with unique two-finger controls that make every move feel incredibly realistic"
  • 4 Pics 1 Word+: "The globally popular puzzle game played by over 400 million players, challenging your mind while keeping things fun"

All the '+' titles are existing App Store games — these special Arcade versions simply remove the ads and in-app purchases. Pusheen's Place and River City Survivors are entirely new games that have yet to appear on the App Store.

Are you an Apple Arcade subscriber? Which games are your favourites? Feel free to share with us in the comments.

Apple Arcade costs $6.99 per month, or you can bundle it via an Apple One subscription. Subscribers get unlimited access to over 200 premium games — no ads, no in-app purchases.
